content.label: Examiner note - describe what you actually see
content.body: Observations earn marks when they are specific: write 'fizzing/bubbling/effervescing', never just 'a gas is given off'. Compare sodium with potassium using 'fizzes more vigorously', 'moves around more quickly', 'disappears more quickly'. And write the metal as (s) - the book warns that (l) for molten sodium confuses examiners.
